verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents both parts of the story. Domains stay transfer-locked until the owner unlocks them, and registry lock with out-of-band verification is offered for high-profile domains, though only to Enterprise customers. Both claims come from short marketing-page lines rather than in-depth docs. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on lock behavior and the registry-lock workflow, registry lock outside the Enterprise plan, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, my domains can be locked down — transfer lock by default and a registry-lock option for the domains that must never move

citations.quote: Your domains stay locked to help prevent unauthorized transfers until you choose to unlock them.
Enterprise customers can safeguard high-profile domains with registry lock and custom out-of-band verification for ownership and nameserver changes.
